title: Technology with warmth.
AI for everyday life.
hero.intro: We are tAistro. From knowledge inside an organization to a conversation in the field, we bring AI integration, knowledge management and digital humans together in tools people want to use.
hero.note: Good technology begins with understanding people.

approach.title: Understand the setting. Then build for it.
approach.intro: Practicality, stability and room to grow guide every service we design.

principles.title: Designed around people
principles.description: We begin with how people speak and work, turning complex technology into clear, approachable interactions.

principles.title: Built for the field
principles.description: We learn how public services and businesses operate, then connect AI to the work already happening.

principles.title: Security from the start
principles.description: We consider information security in system design, with architecture that supports gradual adoption and expansion.

leadership.title: The people who turn ideas into practice.
leadership.intro: Across operations, finance and business development, we keep technical decisions connected to real needs.
